description: Rotate FK bones on a character — the direct way to build or adjust a pose. Values are absolute local euler angles in degrees, so repeating a call is idempotent; read the current ones from studio_list_bones. Pass as many bones as you like in one call: they become a single undo step in Studio. Requires mode 'fk' (studio_set_character_kinematics) and the bone's FK group to be on, and the bone to be weighted — the call refuses rather than storing a rotation Studio would never apply. Bones rotate only; use studio_set_character_ik to move things in space.

bones.description: one entry per bone: the bone name from studio_list_bones mapped to absolute local euler angles [x, y, z] in degrees

output.description: same shape as studio_list_bones, restricted to the bones this call touched ('ik_targets' is empty)
